quest.51301101A6CE6540.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Hammer of Kingbdogz (aether:hammer_of_kingbdogz). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301101A6CE6540.title: Obtain 1 × Hammer of Kingbdogz
quest.513011039AD8F208.quest_desc: Craft an Altar with one Zanite Gemstone in the center and eight Holystone around it. Fuel it with Ambrosium Shards and insert Gravitite Ore to produce Enchanted Gravitite.
Reserve one enchanted block for a batch of two Dimensional Matrices before spending it on Gravitite equipment. A regular furnace cannot perform the required enchanting process.
quest.513011039AD8F208.title: Obtain 1 × Enchanted Gravitite

quest.5130111A101FFA81.quest_desc: Gravitite Ore is a rare Aether ore that rises when no block is above it. Watch the space over a vein while mining so you do not lose track of ore that floats upward.
The drop is the Gravitite Ore block itself. Keep it for processing in an Altar: the Dimensional Matrix requires Enchanted Gravitite, which raw ore cannot replace.
quest.5130111A101FFA81.title: Obtain 1 × Gravitite Ore

quest.5130113516A2F6B6.quest_desc: Craft a Cold Parachute from four Cold Aerclouds in a 2×2 square. It has only one use, so you need a replacement after using it.
Keep it accessible before crossing between Aether islands. Owning the item completes this quest without testing it; learn its use from a low height before relying on it during a long fall.

quest.5130119FB3C70221.quest_desc: Craft a Golden Parachute from four Golden Aerclouds in a 2×2 square. It has twenty uses, providing more descents for Aether exploration while still having a finite supply.
Check its remaining uses before a long expedition and keep materials for a replacement. The parachute helps with descent; plan a separate route back up to high islands.

quest.513011BE0B81B33E.quest_desc: Ambrosium Shards fuel the Altar. Reserve some of your first stock for enchanting Gravitite Ore so you can obtain the Enchanted Gravitite needed by the Dimensional Matrix.
The shards can also provide lighting or be eaten for a small heal. Divide your stock before a long expedition so those uses do not leave the Altar without fuel.
